concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-alipay-plus]] — 2026-09-15 Alipay+ cross-border 11-wallet redirect-network overview with dated capability marks, wallet-specific onboarding review and a TrueMoney Support-form exception; no merchant or wallet-level enablement proof.
warnings: The summary table (raw lines 29–31) is an overview-level capability matrix, not wallet-by-wallet or merchant-specific eligibility; do not infer ordinary-capture status from separate/partial capture x marks.
The one-month onboarding SLA is described as expected, while each wallet applies its own review (raw line 51); no approval guarantee follows.
The TrueMoney onboarding form is to be completed by Adyen Support and submitted to Alipay+ on the merchant's behalf (raw line 53), not a merchant self-service step.
